correction: A sync.status answer shows only when it answers the last ask and no sync.changed of the vault came while it ran; otherwise the event's status stays and the status is asked again. An event and an answer travel apart and either can be the newer: a late event from before a leave, or an older ask's answer, would bring back the hub the vault left, and no event follows a leave.
